sentences.en: I have no time to listen to such everyday affairs.
sentences.zh: 我根本没有时间去听那些日常琐事。

sentences.en: Hobbies take your mind off the worries of everyday life.
sentences.zh: 爱好让你从日常生活中的烦恼中解脱出来。

sentences.en: Even his everyday speech was an off-the-cuff, tangential, disjointed narrative.
sentences.zh: 即使是他平时的讲话也是即兴发挥、离题且杂乱无章的故事。
